ambiguity: You asked for totals per calendar day without saying whose calendar: the timestamps are UTC but the report is read by a team in one office.

facts.fact: A day means a New York calendar day, America/New_York, not a UTC day. Finance reconciles against the New York close.
Key each day by its local date as YYYY-MM-DD.
The order of the keys does not matter.
